latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release with robust n8n workflow automation features.

- Designs and outputs n8n workflows with built-in triggers, idempotency, error handling, logging, retries, and human-in-the-loop review queues.
- Outputs either a workflow design spec or, if requested, importable n8n workflow JSON and a runbook.
- Includes strict guidance for audit trails, approval, and safe failure handling (no silent failures).
- Supports customization via trigger types, schedules, targets, deduplication keys, and existing workflows.
- Read-only by default; never outputs secrets.
